name: Flores + Komodo
tagline: Dragons and manta rays by boat, then a highland road through megalith villages, a hidden village of conical houses and three coloured crater lakes.

access.route: Brussels→Bali via Doha, Singapore or Kuala Lumpur (17–19 h), then Bali→Labuan Bajo (1.5 h)
London→Bali via Doha or Singapore, then Labuan Bajo

nightsNote: 14–17°C in the Flores highlands, 25°C on the coast
whyNotes: Dry season, almost no altitude, and a trip that reads like Colombia in reverse: a boat journey first, then a slow road east through villages where the culture is lived, not displayed. Few foreigners once you leave Labuan Bajo.
fitNotes: Highest point 2,200 m if the siblings climb Inerie; otherwise 1,650 m at Kelimutu. 30°C on the coast, 20–23°C in Bajawa and Ruteng, so the highland days carry the trip. Komodo boats are busy in July and August; the road is not. Long legs of 3–4 h between stops.

blocks.name: Labuan Bajo
see: Boat and guide arrangements for Komodo
blocks.note: Arrival point. Hot; one night either side of the boat.

blocks.name: Ruteng
blocks.place: Manggarai hill town at 1,200 m, spider-web rice fields
blocks.history: Manggarai lingko land system, Homo floresiensis cave

blocks.name: Bajawa + Ngada villages
blocks.place: Bena, Luba, Tololela: megalith villages below Inerie volcano, 1,100 m
see: Bena village (ngadhu and bhaga ancestor shrines)
Luba and Tololela on foot between villages
Malanage hot springs where a hot and a cold river meet

blocks.name: Moni + Ende
blocks.place: Village below Kelimutu, Sukarno's exile house in Ende

blocks.name: Maumere + Sikka
blocks.place: 16th-century Portuguese church, Ledalero museum, departure airport
see: Bikon Blewut museum at Ledalero seminary

blocks.name: Komodo by boat
blocks.place: 3 days on a liveaboard: dragons on Rinca and Komodo, Padar ridge, manta point, pink beach
see: Padar island ridge walk at dawn (the three bays)
Komodo dragons with a ranger on Komodo or Rinca
Snorkel with mantas at Karang Makassar
Sleep on deck under the stars
blocks.note: The one crowded block. A private boat for five (~€150 pp per day) avoids the day-trip fleet by moving earlier.

blocks.name: Wae Rebo
blocks.place: Seven conical Mbaru Niang houses at 1,100 m, 3 h walk in through cloud forest
blocks.history: Manggarai ancestral village, UNESCO Asia-Pacific heritage award
see: Walk in from Denge (3 h, 600 m up)
Welcome ceremony and a night in the communal house
Coffee drying on the terraces at dawn
Walk out and drive on to Ruteng

blocks.name: Kelimutu
blocks.place: Three crater lakes that change colour, 1,640 m, dawn
see: Walk back down to Moni through the villages (3 h, instead of the car)

blocks.name: Inerie volcano + Bajawa walks
blocks.place: Perfect cone to 2,245 m for the siblings; village paths for everyone
see: Inerie summit at dawn (4 h up, steep scree)

blocks.name: Riung 17 Islands
blocks.place: Marine park on the north coast, snorkel and flying foxes
see: Boat to three or four islands
Dry savannah hills, unlike the south

blocks.name: Bali highlands: Munduk
blocks.place: Waterfalls, rice terraces and temples at 800–1,200 m, as a start or end
blocks.note: Cooler and quieter than the south of Bali; useful to break the flights.

notes: Dry season: 30°C on the coast, 20–23°C in the highlands, almost no rain.
Komodo waters are calmest and the dragons most active in the dry months.
The Trans-Flores road is paved but slow: budget 4 h for each hop.
July: Komodo boats are at their busiest with Indonesian and European holidays; book a private boat.
August: the Komodo fleet thins after the Indonesian holidays end.

lodgingAssumption: Local B&B or Airbnb, two rooms for five, one meal out a day; shared van or hire car
